intro: For months, Noboru has tormented the Draenei at the Harborage. Noboru's cudgel stands as a mark of the cruelty the lost ones have dealt them, and you are asked to bring it to the leader of the Harborage.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Noboru has plagued the Draenei of the Harborage for months, and his cudgel is a symbol of the brutality they have suffered at the hands of the lost ones.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings. And welcome to the Harborage.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have gained the weapon of the dreaded Noboru? Is he then dead?

This is a joyous day for the Harborage. Noboru and his gang were a terror to us, wandering the swamps and killing any Draenei who crossed his path. He was a direct threat to our survival, and we did not have the strength to face him.
We are fortunate to have a friend in you, friend.
